registryCustodian: Cyprus Department of Lands and Surveys (DLS) owns the official national cadastral-map portal and public ArcGIS REST service; no separate Limassol municipal parcel service was evidenced.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Greek discovery queries found official Gov.cy/DLS map pages and the live DLS English and Greek cadastral ArcGIS REST services. The service layer metadata and bounded anonymous query verified public parcel polygons near the exact WUP point.
requestOutcomes: Official pages and layer metadata returned 200. The 1 km bounded query returned three Polygon features with native SBPI_ID_NO values. Exact-point identify returned zero features; this is not an absence claim. No credentials, login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, private token, TLS exception, or unsafe field request was used.

schemaAndCrs.parcelSchema: National/CadastralMap_EN/MapServer/0 Parcels; Greek counterpart layer 0 ΤΕΜΑΧΙΑ
schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: EPSG:3857 native service metadata; bounded response requested EPSG:4326
schemaAndCrs.compositeKeyProvenance: SBPI_ID_NO is the official returned parcel identifier; source cadastral components DIST_CODE, VIL_CODE, QRTR_CODE, BLCK_CODE and PARCEL_NBR were documented but not retained as feature properties.

scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [34.6909748253836, 33.0357356736213] was preserved and not shifted.
Three returned polygons are bounded sample evidence, not citywide coverage proof; exact-point zero is not evidence of absence.
The national DLS service does not by itself qualify a runtime adapter or prove Limassol municipal completeness.
No unsafe personal, ownership, title, address, contact, tax/account, certificate, or title fields were requested or retained.
No GeoJSON sample was retained; unchanged raw response is in ignored tmp evidence only.

qualification.reason: Safe native IDs and polygon geometry were verified in a bounded anonymous response, but independent serial review and citywide coverage qualification remain required.

uncertainty: Public DLS parcel access is verified, but local citywide completeness, update cadence, exact viewer configuration beyond the REST layer, and production adapter suitability remain unverified.
